Home.exploreDescription: Reba amaraporo ukurikije ahantu, ibibazo, indimi n'igihe kugira ngo usobanukirwe ibibera ku isi.
Home.faq1Answer: WatchTower n'igikoresho cyo gutanga raporo mu ndimi nyinshi n'ubwenge mu by'umuturage, gifasha abantu gutanga raporo ku bibazo by'abaturage n'ibirego by'uburenganzira mu ndimi bavuga. Raporo zishobora kugenerwa amakarita no gusesengurwa kugira ngo haboneke imiterere y'ibintu bigatuma dufata ingamba.
Home.faq2Answer: Urashobora gutanga raporo ku bibazo nk'ibirego by'uburenganzira, ibibazo by'umutekano n'ibindi bibazo by'abaturage biri mu karere kawe: ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose abandi bakwiye kumenya cyangwa gishobora gufasha kumenya iby'abaho kugira ngo ufate ingamba.
Home.faq2Question: Ni iki nshobora gutanga raporo kuri WatchTower?
Home.faq3Answer: Yego. Urashobora gutanga raporo ukoresheje ijwi cyangwa inyandiko mu rurimi urushimisha cyane, kandi WatchTower ifasha kwandika ibivugwa, gusobanura mu zindi ndimi no gutunganya raporo yawe kugira ngo yumvikane mu ndimi zose.
Home.faq3Question: Nshobora gutanga raporo mu rurimi rwanjye?
Home.faq4Answer: Yego. Kutamenyekana ni ibisanzwe, si ikindi: ntubasha gutanga izina ryawe cyangwa makuru aryo amenyekanisha kugira ngo ugere raporo.
Home.faq5Answer: Buri raporo irakorwa ikaba ikemerwa, iherwa amakarita hamwe n'izindi kugira ngo haboneke imiterere y'ibintu, kandi ikanabagirwa ku miturire, imiryango n'ibigo bishobora gufata ingamba hashingiwe kuri yo.
Home.faq5Question: Biki biba nyuma yo gutanga raporo?
Home.faqsDescription: Menya byinshi ku bihereranye no gutanga raporo, indimi, ibanga ry'amakuru n'ukuntu WatchTower ifasha guhindura amakuru y'abaturage kuba agira akamaro.
Home.heroDescription: Watchtower ifasha abantu gutanga raporo ku bibazo by'aho batuye n'ibirego by'uburenganzira mu ndimi bavuga, kugira ngo buri wese ashobore kugira uruhare mu buzima bw'abenegihugu no mu kubazwa rusange.
Home.howItWorksDescription: Kuva ku raporo imwe kugeza ku impinduka zigera ku rwego rw'igihugu, uku ni ko WatchTower ifasha abaturage kumvikanisha ijwi ryabo no gutuma haba impinduka zifite agaciro.
Home.insightsDescription: Suzuma imyumvire ku bihereranye no gutanga raporo ku nsonga z'abaturage, kwitabira imikorere y'igihugu, ikoranabuhanga ry'indimi nyinshi n'ukuntu amakuru meza ashobora gufasha gufata ingamba zifite akamaro.
Home.insightsFallback1Title: Impamvu amajwi yo mu karere atuma tumenya ibibera hasi
Home.insightsFallback2Title: Kumena inzitizi y'ururimi mu gutanga raporo ku nsonga z'igihugu
Home.insightsFallback3Title: Kuva ku raporo z'umuntu umwe kugeza ku miterere ikomeye
Home.insightsHeading: Ibitekerezo, inkuru n'ubushishozi biva mu mirima.
Home.speakNaturallyDescription: WatchTower yandika ibivugwa, isobanura mu zindi ndimi kandi igatunganya raporo, kugira ngo amakuru yumvikane, ururimi urwo ari rwo rwose rwakoreshejwe mu kuvuga ikibazo.
Home.speakNaturallyTitle: Andika raporo mu buryo busanzwe<break></break>mu rurimi rwawe.
Home.step1Description: Dutanga ikoranabuhanga rifasha abantu n'imiryango gutanga raporo ku bibazo by'aho batuye cyangwa ibirego by'uburenganzira, mu buryo butaziguye biva kuri telefoni yabo cyangwa mudasobwa mu rurimi bavuga.
Home.step2Description: Dukora kandi tugenzura buri raporo, tugashushanya ibyabaye ku ikarita kandi tukagaragaza uko bigenda bimeze kera byakwiye kutamenyekana. Amakuru y'ibanze ahinduka ubumenyi bugaragara kandi butunganijwe buvuga inkuru nini.
Home.step3Description: Abaturage, imiryango n'inzego bakoresha ubu bumenyi kugira ngo bubake ibirego, babaze ababifitiye inshingano, kandi bagatera imbere ku mpinduka zifite agaciro, zishingiye ku bimenyetso by'ukuri byavuye ku isi.
Home.impactDescription: Menya uko abaturage bamvikanisha ijwi ryabo, bagatuma habaho ibyemezo kandi bagatuma haba ibikorwa.
About.ctaDescription: Tanga raporo y'ikibazo cy'abenegihugu mu rurimi rwawe. Nta konti isabwa, nta makuru bwite asabwa.
About.faqAccountAnswer: Nta murongo ugomba gukorwa cyangwa kwinjira gukurikiranwa. Uza, utanga raporo, ugenda. Nta kintu kigufatanya n'ibyo watanze.
About.faqDeviceAnswer: Yego. WatchTower ntibika amakuru ya sesiyo cyangwa cookies bifitanye isano n'ibyo watanze. Gutanga raporo ukoresheje mudasobwa isangiwe ntibikubangamira.
About.faqDeviceQuestion: Ese nshobora gutanga raporo nkoresheje mudasobwa isangiwe cyangwa iy'abantu bose?
About.faqEncryptionAnswer: Ibyo watanze byose birabikwa mu buryo bwihariye guhera igihe uzitanze. Raporo yawe ntishobora gufatwa cyangwa kugarukwaho igihe iri kohererezwa.
About.faqEncryptionQuestion: Ese ibyo natanze bishobora kugera kuri njye bikamenyekana?
About.faqIdentityAnswer: Nta na rimwe usabwa gutanga izina ryawe, nimero ya telefoni, cyangwa amakuru ay'ubwoko bwose amenyekanisha kugira ngo utange raporo. Kutamenyekana ni bwo buryo busanzwe, ntabwo ari itandukaniro.
About.faqIdentityQuestion: Ese umwirondoro wanjye urarindwa iyo natanze raporo?
About.faqVisibilityAnswer: Raporo zisuzumwa gusa n'abakozi ba WatchTower bemejwe. Ibyo watanze ntibigabanywa ku mugaragaro hamwe n'amakuru amenyekanisha.
About.heroDescription: WatchTower ni urubuga rw'ubwenge bw'abenegihugu rushingiye ku baturage, rukoresha AI n'ikoranabuhanga ry'indimi z'aho abantu batuye kugira ngo bafashe abantu gutanga raporo ku bibaye, ingaruka n'ibirego by'uburenganzira mu ndimi zabo bwite, kandi bihindura izo raporo mu bumenyi bushobora gukoreshwa mu kubazwa no gusubiza.
About.heroTitle: Guhindura amajwi y'abantu ku giti cyabo ibikorwa
About.languagesDescription: WatchTower yubatswe hashingiwe ku ndimi abantu bakoresha koko. Ururimi rugaragara mu gihe cyose cyo gutanga raporo, bigafasha abantu kuvuga uko basanzwe mu gihe amakuru yumvikana mu ndimi zitandukanye.
About.objectiveDescription: Kwemeza ko buri muntu afite ubushobozi bwo gutanga raporo ku bibazo by'abenegihugu mu rurimi avuga, kugira ngo nta jwi ridasobanutse kandi buri wese ashobore kugira uruhare mu kubaza ababifitiye inshingano.
About.safetyDescription: Tuzi ko kuvuga bishobora kuzana ingaruka. Aha niho WatchTower yubatswe kugira ngo ikurinde.
Security.metaDescription: Uko wagira uburyo butanga raporo neza ku ntege nke z'umutekano ku itsinda rya AmplifiedAccess.
Security.heroDescription: Uko dukemura raporo z'intege nke n'ubusabane bwacu bwo kubikuza mu buryo bwuzuye inshingano.
Security.intro: AmplifiedAccess ifata umutekano wa WatchTower nk'ikintu gikomeye. Dushimira imihati y'abashakashatsi b'umutekano n'abagize umuryango badufasha gukomeza urubuga rufite umutekano ku bantu bose.
Security.reportingWarning: Nyamuneka ntutange raporo z'intege nke z'umutekano ukoresheje ibibazo bya GitHub biboneka ku mugaragaro.
Security.reportingInstruction: Ahubwo, bitange butaziguye ku itsinda ryacu ukoresheje email:
Security.reportingResponseTime: Ugomba kubona igisubizo mu masaha 48. Niba utabonye, nyamuneka ukurikirane ukoresheje email kugira ngo wemeze ko twabonye ubutumwa bwawe bwa mbere.
Security.whatToIncludeIntro: Kugira ngo udufashe gusuzuma raporo yawe vuba bishoboka, nyamuneka shyiramo byinshi mu bikurikira uko ushoboye:
Security.includeItem1: Ubwoko bw'ikibazo (urugero, SQL injection, cross-site scripting, authentication bypass, privilege escalation, n'ibindi)
Security.includeItem2: Amayira yuzuye y'inyandiko-mbanjwe bifitanye isano n'uko ikibazo cyagaragaye
Security.includeItem3: Aho code yagizweho ingaruka iherereye (ishami, commit hash, cyangwa URL butaziguye)
Security.includeItem4: Igenamiterere idasanzwe iyariyo yose ikenewe kongera kubona ikibazo
Security.includeItem5: Amabwiriza intambwe ku yindi yo kongera kubona ikibazo
Security.includeItem6: Ikimenyetso cy'igitekerezo cyangwa code ya exploit, niba bishoboka
Security.includeItem7: Ingaruka z'ikibazo, harimo n'uko umugizi wa nabi yagikoresha
Security.disclosurePolicy: AmplifiedAccess ikurikiza umugambi w'<link>Kubikuza Intege Nke mu Buryo Buhuriweho</link>. Tubasaba kuduha igihe gihagije cyo gusuzuma no gukemura ikibazo cyatanzwe raporo mbere y'uko habaho ikindi kibikuza ku mugaragaro.
Security.disclosureFollowUp: Tuzabamenyesha aho tugeze mu bushakashatsi kandi tukabashimira ibyo mwavumbuye niba mubishaka.
Security.languageText: Dushaka ko itumanaho ryose ry'umutekano ribera mu Cyongereza.
CodeOfConduct.metaDescription: Ibipimo by'umuryango wa AmplifiedAccess n'amahame y'imyitwarire ku bafatanyabikorwa n'abagize uruhare.
CodeOfConduct.heroDescription: Ubusabane bwacu ku muryango ufunguye, wakira abantu, kandi udafite ihohoterwa ku bantu bose.
CodeOfConduct.pledgeText1: Nk'abagize umuryango, abafatanyabikorwa, n'abayobozi b'umuryango wa AmplifiedAccess, twiyemeje gutuma kugira uruhare mu muryango wacu biba ubunararibonye budafite ihohoterwa ku bantu bose, hatitawe ku myaka, ingano y'umubiri, ubumuga bugaragara cyangwa butagaragara, ubwoko, ibiranga igitsina, umwirondoro n'imigaragarize by'igitsina, urwego rw'ubunararibonye, uburezi, imibereho y'ubukungu, ubwenegihugu, imigaragarize bwite, ubwoko, icyiciro, ibara, idini, cyangwa umwirondoro n'irerero by'igitsina.
CodeOfConduct.pledgeText2: Twiyemeje gukora no gukorana mu buryo butera imbere umuryango ufunguye, wakira abantu, utandukanye, utavangura kandi ufite ubuzima bwiza.
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositiveIntro: Urugero rw'imyitwarire itera imbere ibidukikije byiza harimo:
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive1: Kugaragaza impuhwe n'ineza ku bandi bantu
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive3: Gutanga no kwemera mu bwitonzi ibitekerezo byubaka
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive4: Kwiyemeza inshingano no gusaba imbabazi ku bagizweho ingaruka n'amakosa yacu, no kwiga kubinyuze mu bunararibonye
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive5: Kwibanda ku byiza si gusa kuri twe nk'abantu ku giti cyacu, ahubwo ku muryango wose
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative1: Gukoresha ururimi cyangwa amashusho y'igitsina, n'ibindi byose byerekeye ubushake bw'igitsina
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative2: Gucuruza no gutera abandi ubwoba, ibitekerezo byo gusuzugura cyangwa gutuka, n'ibitero bwite cyangwa bya politiki
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative4: Gutangaza amakuru bwite y'abandi, nk'aderesi y'aho batuye cyangwa iy'imeri, nta ruhushya rusobanutse
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative5: Indi myitwarire iyariyo yose ishobora kubonwa nk'idakwiye mu bikorwa by'akazi
CodeOfConduct.enforcementResponsibilitie: Abayobozi b'umuryango wa AmplifiedAccess bafite inshingano yo gusobanura no gushyira mu bikorwa ibipimo byacu by'imyitwarire yemewe kandi bazafata ingamba zikwiye kandi zifite ubunyangamugayo mu gusubiza imyitwarire iyariyo yose babona ari idakwiye, iteye ubwoba, itesha agaciro, cyangwa itera akaga.

Abayobozi b'umuryango bafite uburenganzira n'inshingano yo gukuraho, guhindura, cyangwa kwanga ibitekerezo, commits, code, ibihinduka bya wiki, ibibazo, n'ibindi byatanzwe bidahuye n'aya Mahame y'Imyitwarire, kandi bazatanga impamvu z'ibyemezo byo kugenzura igihe bikenewe.
CodeOfConduct.scopeText: Aya Mahame y'Imyitwarire akoreshwa mu bibanza byose by'umuryango, kandi akoreshwa n'igihe umuntu ari uhagarariye mu buryo bwemewe umuryango wa AmplifiedAccess mu bibanza rusange. Urugero rwo guhagararira umuryango wacu harimo gukoresha aderesi y'imeri yemewe, gutangaza ukoresheje konti y'imbuga nkoranyambaga yemewe, cyangwa gukora nk'uhagarariye watorewe mu muhango wo kuri interineti cyangwa udaturuka kuri interineti.
CodeOfConduct.reportingIntro: Ibintu by'imyitwarire mibi, ihohoterwa, cyangwa indi myitwarire idakwiye bishobora gutangwa raporo ku itsinda rya AmplifiedAccess kuri:
CodeOfConduct.reportingFollowUp: Ikirego cyose kizasuzumwa kandi gikagenzurwa vuba kandi mu bunyangamugayo. Abayobozi bose b'umuryango bafite inshingano yo kubaha ibanga n'umutekano w'utanga raporo ku kintu iki n'iki cyabaye.
CodeOfConduct.guidelinesIntro: Abayobozi b'umuryango bazakurikiza aya mabwiriza mu gufata icyemezo ku ngaruka z'igikorwa icyo aricyo cyose babona ko kinyuranyije n'Amahame y'Imyitwarire:
CodeOfConduct.correctionImpactText: Gukoresha ururimi rudakwiye cyangwa indi myitwarire ibonwa ko idafite umwuga cyangwa itakiriwe mu muryango.
CodeOfConduct.correctionConsequenceText: Umuburo w'ibanga wanditse uva ku bayobozi b'umuryango, utanga ubusobanuro ku bijyanye n'imiterere y'ikosa n'ubusobanuro bw'impamvu imyitwarire itari ikwiye. Imbabazi ku mugaragaro zishobora gusabwa.
CodeOfConduct.warningImpactText: Ikosa rikozwe binyuze mu gikorwa kimwe cyangwa ibikorwa byinshi bikurikirana.
CodeOfConduct.warningConsequenceText: Umuburo ufite ingaruka ku myitwarire ikomeje. Nta bucuti n'abagize uruhare, harimo n'ubucuti butifuzwa n'abashyira mu bikorwa Amahame y'Imyitwarire, mu gihe cyagenwe. Kutubahiriza aya mabwiriza bishobora gutuma habaho ihagarikwa ry'igihe gito cyangwa ry'iteka.
CodeOfConduct.temporaryBanImpactText: Ikosa rikomeye ku bipimo by'umuryango, harimo imyitwarire idakwiye ikomeje.
CodeOfConduct.temporaryBanConsequenceTex: Ihagarikwa ry'igihe gito ry'ubwoko bwose bw'ubucuti cyangwa itumanaho rusange n'umuryango mu gihe cyagenwe. Nta bucuti rusange cyangwa bw'ibanga n'abagize uruhare byemewe muri iki gihe. Kutubahiriza aya mabwiriza bishobora gutuma habaho ihagarikwa ry'iteka.
CodeOfConduct.permanentBanImpactText: Kugaragaza uburyo bw'ikosa ku bipimo by'umuryango, harimo imyitwarire idakwiye ikomeje, ihohoterwa ry'umuntu, cyangwa ibitero cyangwa gusuzugura amatsinda y'abantu.
CodeOfConduct.permanentBanConsequenceTex: Ihagarikwa ry'iteka ry'ubwoko bwose bw'ubucuti rusange mu muryango.
CodeOfConduct.attributionText: Aya Mahame y'Imyitwarire yavuye ku <covenantLink>Contributor Covenant</covenantLink>, verisiyo 2.1, iboneka kuri <versionLink>contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct</versionLink>.
PrivacyPolicyPage.heading: Politiki y'Ibanga
About.step1Description: Tanga raporo y'ikibazo wanditse cyangwa uvuga, mu rurimi wumva neza. Ongeraho ibisobanuro, aho byabereye n'ibimenyetso igihe bikenewe.
About.step2Description: WatchTower itondeka raporo hakurikijwe ahantu, indimi n'ibibazo, bigatuma ibikorwa bifitanye isano n'ibigenda bisubirwamo byumvikana byoroshye.
About.step3Description: Koresha raporo zihuriweho n'ibimenyetso by'abaturage mu gushyigikira iperereza, kubazwa inshingano, ubuvugizi n'ibyemezo bifite ishingiro.
About.audienceCommunitiesDescription: Tanga raporo ku bibazo n'ibyo uhura na byo aho utuye, mu rurimi wumva neza.
About.audienceOrganisationsDescription: Akira kandi usuzume raporo, ucunge ibikorwa kandi umenye imigendekere mu baturage batandukanye.
About.audienceEvidenceDescription: Abashakashatsi, abanyamakuru n'imiryango iharanira inyungu rusange bashobora gusesengura raporo, ahantu n'imigendekere kugira ngo barusheho kumva ibyo abaturage bahura na byo.
About.heroIntro: WatchTower itangirira ku gitekerezo cyoroshye: korohereza abantu gutanga raporo ku bibera aho batuye, hanyuma izo raporo zikagira akamaro kurushaho hatibagiranye abantu bazitanze.
